response.evidence: Hispanic or Latino White males in the 35-44 age range show a 93.8% approval rate (151/161 applications) compared to 92.4% overall approval rate. The denial rate for this demographic (6.2%) is actually slightly lower than the overall denial rate (7.6%), indicating no evidence of discrimination against this group in the dataset.

Among applicants with similar financial profiles (debt-to-income ratios >60%, or income <$50K), Hispanic or Latino White males show comparable denial rates to other demographic groups. For example, denials occur across all demographics with high DTI ratios (>60%) or very low incomes regardless of ethnicity. The data shows successful loan originations for Hispanic or Latino White males across all age groups including 35-44, with approval rates consistent with other groups when controlling for financial factors.

Analysis of 35-44 year-old Hispanic/Latino White males shows 94 loan originations vs 11 denials (89.5% approval rate). This is comparable to similar demographic groups: 35-44 White males (not Hispanic/Latino) have 88.6% approval rate, and the overall dataset shows approximately 88% approval rate across all applicants. No statistical evidence of discrimination against this demographic group is present in the data.
